items.html: Ross Duncan was a fast-medium bowler who on his day could swing the ball viciously. He took 13 for 125 for Queensland against Victoria at Melbourne and subsequently played  one Test against England at Melbourne later that summer  but failed to take a wicket. At the end of the year he moved to Victoria but played only one more season.
